content: Rohan Deshmukh contacted insurance agent Vikram Patel to check the status of his life insurance policy. Vikram confirmed the policy is active with recent updates of ₹15 lakh Sum Assured and a ₹5 lakh Accidental Death rider. Rohan requested a copy of the latest policy document, which Vikram successfully sent as a PDF. Rohan also inquired about his next premium due date, and Vikram informed him it is due on 15 October 2026. No further changes or issues were reported.

action_items: Send reminder for premium due a week before 15 October 2026
